items.question: Which subatomic particle carries a positive charge?
Define the concept of an isotope and give an example.
items.answer: An isotope is an atom having the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons. Example: Carbon-12 and Carbon-14.

What is the role of a limiting reactant in a chemical reaction?
items.answer: A limiting reactant is the ingredient that is completely consumed first in a reaction, thus determining the maximum amount of product that can be formed.
